newsitem.title: ZAIRE: U.N. envoy arrives to assess Zaire ethnic conflict.
newsitem.headline: U.N. envoy arrives to assess Zaire ethnic conflict.

text.p: A special U.N. envoy arrived in eastern Zaire on Sunday to assess how to stop fighting between the Zaire army and ethnic Tutsis.

"I am sent here as a special envoy of the United Nations Secretary General to try and find out as much as possible about the situation here on the ground," envoy Ibrahima Fall told reporters as he arrived in Bukavu. "I will be meeting with the local administration but also with as many other actors in the area as possible."
Asked if his brief was to stop the conflict drawing in the armies of Rwanda and Burundi, both dominated by Tutsis, Fall said: "If I am able to, so much the better."
As the envoy flew into Bukavu from the Zaire capital Kinshasa, aid workers said Banyamulenge Tutsi rebels had cut a section of the highway between Bukavu and Uvira.
Aid workers in Uvira also said many people had been killed and wounded in renewed fighting between the Zairean military and Banyamulenge rebels in north Uvira.
